question: Use the Kruskal-Wallis test to determine if tumor mutational burden (TMB) differs across four cancer types. If significant, perform Dunn's post-hoc test to identify which specific cancer types differ from each other.

expected_output.guidelines: All six pairwise significance calls (True/False) must match the reference; row order and column header labels may differ.
H statistic must match within 0.1% relative absolute error; significance call must match; column order and header labels may differ.
